crossRefs.note: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from…
“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all…
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

translations.web: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
translations.bsb: Who are these who fly like clouds, like doves to their shelters?
translations.kjv: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
translations.asv: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
